decisions.reason: The source change concerns the format and detail level of the separate result-explanation section; the dashboard's score fields, heading, and prominence remain unchanged.
Presenting weaknesses as concise bullets does not change whether weaknesses or other customer-specific fields remain editable.
The result-explanation refinement does not change the footer's presentation, coverage, or report identifier.
Moving longer explanatory content elsewhere if needed does not necessarily change the internal-page header or its scope.

The candidate already records the message's general readability and refinement priorities; section-specific bullet formatting belongs to the source Requirement and requires no further broad-style update.
The front-page explanation change does not alter the final-page confidentiality warning.
The explanation's presentation and detail level do not change the required RR-01 identifier or its consistency.
The content-layout refinement does not change the required editable formats, report variants, or PDF-export capability.
The source change does not modify score-to-template selection, risk-band mapping, or exposure-level mapping.
The front-page explanation refinement does not alter the required fonts, icons, design assets, or handoff obligations.
